name: deviation_agent
description: Detects anomalies in SECOM manufacturing datasets using a pre-trained Isolation Forest model stored in S3. Must always be the first agent called in the pipeline.

skills.name: run_deviation_detection
skills.description: Run Isolation Forest anomaly detection on a SECOM dataset stored in S3. Takes a dataset S3 bucket and key, returns a deviation output S3 URI with anomalous row indices and scores. This is always the entry point of the pipeline — call this first before any other agent.
